column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I Get Deja Vú In My Room
It's just like Mom said.
She seems different from usual...
Explain. Just what the heck are these?
Stop joking around. This mountain of otaku goods all belongs to you.
...Huh? I don't understand what you're saying. Please speak in Japanese.
Or, if you're actually saying that seriously, shouldn't you go to the hospital?
Ah? What... are you saying?
...That's what I'm asking you.
Like I said, aren't these the treasures that you've collected?
Geez, are you still half asleep?
...Do you think such lies will work on me!?
I'm not lying to you. These are all yours.
Huh? This is getting old already, so could you please stop with the lies?
That's enough from you too. What reason would I have to lie to you?
T-That's... but...
...You, what are you trying to do?
Even I wouldn't make such a boring ruckus in the middle of the night.
That's why I want you to give me a clear answer!
Clear? What do you want to be made clear?
A clear proof of how these gross things aren't mine!
No, 100% of it is all yours.
S-Shut up! In any case, aren't all of those yours!? Hurry up and take them away!
This girl, is she serious? How selfish is she going to get!?
It's very possible that since your room has no space to hide them, you came over to my room to hide them, right!?
Like I said, it's not like that! Rather, what's wrong with you?
Somehow... it feels like you're different from usual.
H-Huh?  What are you saying...? I'm being myself.
*sigh*...Do you seriously think you are?
W-What... are you still playing dumb?
Guess there's no helping it... I'll go along with this farce here.
...Furthermore, are these things you would hide in your sister's room? There should be much better places aren't there?
How would I know? That's why I called you over here like this.
Also, the souvenir from Kyoto is also similar to these...
Similar to these... are you talking about the Regional Edition Meruru?
Yes, that's why I thought all of these are yours.
*sigh* You're just incomprehensible!
I've been listening to your nonsense quietly since the beginning! The one that's being incomprehensible is you!
W-What's with that!?
What... the heck is wrong with you...
Hmph, how long are you going to play dumb?
I've nothing more to say to you. Leave, now.
Tch, this girl... how long does she intend to make fun of me?
We had a long and tedious talk, but in the end it's still a farce.
I have nothing to say to you.
Shut up! Anyway, this is all your fault!
What's with that?
T-That's because, after you came back from Kyoto, nothing but strange things have been happening...
Huh? Now that's something I don't have to know.
Tch... Enough. It was stupid of me to ask you about it anyways.
This girl.... How much does she intend to ridicule me?
